component.name: Bitter Browser
component.summary: Focused, native web browser for the Linux desktop

description.p: Bitter Browser is an experimental web browser built with Rust, GTK 4, libadwaita and WebKitGTK. It keeps tabs in a vertical sidebar and organizes them in two workspaces.

ul.li: Two workspaces with their own tab order and selection
Session restore that loads only the selected tab at startup
Address bar suggestions from local history, bookmarks and open tabs
Native error pages with retry for connection and certificate failures
Downloads with safe file names, progress and cancel
Find in page, zoom and full screen
Light, dark and system color schemes

description.p: The project is experimental. It includes ad and tracker blocking and an optional HTTPS-only mode.

screenshot.caption: History in the dark color scheme
Bookmarks in the light color scheme

description.p: Bookmark title editing, more accessible tabs, and fixes for address editing and diagnostic privacy.

ul.li: Edit a saved bookmark title from the command palette or with Ctrl+Shift+D
Sidebar tabs expose accessible names and loading state
Escape restores the current address while editing the address bar

description.p: A command-line launcher, removing single pages from history and reliability fixes.

ul.li: Remove a single page from the History page
The bitter-cli launcher opens addresses from scripts and terminals
Addresses with a user name and password are no longer saved in history
Switching or moving tabs in an empty workspace no longer crashes the browser
Downloaded filter lists larger than 8 MiB are rejected

description.p: Sign-in pop-ups, site permissions, ad and tracker blocking, HTTPS-only mode and reorganized preferences.

ul.li: Pages opened with window.open become tabs that keep their opener, so sign-in and payment windows work
Sites ask before using notifications, location, camera, microphone or the clipboard, and answers are remembered per site
Ads and trackers are blocked with EasyList and EasyPrivacy, with a per-site switch
HTTPS-only mode, tracking prevention, third-party cookie blocking and clearing browsing data
Context menu items open links in tabs, hovered links show their address, and F12 opens the Web Inspector
Choose where downloads are saved; the download list and per-site zoom survive restarts
Redesigned New Tab, History and Bookmarks pages and a collapsible sidebar

description.p: Fixes the Arch package recipe attached to the release.
Downloads, find in page, zoom, full screen, site icons, workspaces, session restore and address bar suggestions.
